discovery_notes: Cell B414, follow-up 22 of B041 (reuses keys from 397/445/478/505/526/546/564/575/584/592). 28 standard searches; all claims from search-engine summaries of Disney Pins Blog / MezzoMiki / rurubu. New SHDR pins: restaurant trio Nov 2021 (Stitch/Barbossa's Bounty, Rapunzel/Tangled Tree Tavern, Mulan/Wandering Moon), Star Wars + MU spinners Feb 2021, Alice spinner 12 Mar 2021, Storybook Castle double-sided spinner 9 Oct 2021, Hello Spring 2021 (Spring Time OE, Chip & Dale diorama AP, Donald egg LE), Mickey's Pool Party 2022 Donald + Chip n Dale (structure hold). New sets only (structure/mystery holds): Sleeping Princess 2022, Perfume Bottle 2021, hotel pins 2021, Hello Spring 2021 pin set / mystery 6 / box LE500, Pirates treasure-map mystery 8 and two OE pins (Apr 2021), Battle for the Sunken Treasure 3-pin set (Jul 2021), Character Fruit mystery 8 (Jun 2022). Re-used: TDR Halloween 2022 balloon set (date/price), park-logo hold kept, HKDL princess hold kept. Duffy Beautiful Rainy Days resolved as plush badges (scope). No holds released; HKDL Jan 2022 / Jan 2023 untouched. Resellers seen, not used: usshoppingsos, fryguypins, paypay flea market.
